receiptDateTime.description: When the waste was received at the receiver's site.

carrier.description: The carrier that delivered the waste.

receiver.description: The receiver that received the waste.

physicalDetails.description: The physical form, containers and total weight of the waste received.

treatments.description: The disposal or recovery operations applied to the waste received. At least one is required.

brokerOrDealer.description: Any broker or dealer involved in the movement.

supportingReferences.description: References that help identify the receipt, such as a PO or job number.
